preconditions.description: n and k are integers within the specified bounds.
The length of the bead color sequence matches n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in colors)
preconditions.description: Each bead color is a lowercase Latin letter.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == n and all(c in '01' for c in output)
postconditions.description: The output is a binary string of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == '1' if is_regular(colors[:i+1], k) else output[i] == '0' for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each position i (1-based), output[i] is '1' if the first i beads form a regular sequence with parameter k, otherwise '0'.
